name: 股市复盘
description_zh: 通过实时拉取指数行情、个股K线和涨停跌停数据，自动计算市场环境评分、情绪周期、个股趋势评分，并生成内容丰富的复盘总结。
description_en: By pulling real-time index quotes, individual stock K-line data, and limit-up/limit-down statistics, the system automatically computes a market environment score, sentiment cycle, and per-stock trend score, then generates a detailed post-session review.
